name: PufferGo | 外贸独立站AI建站专家 | AI Website Builder for Export
author: puffergo

sections.description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Search for PufferGo in WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New, or manually upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/puffergo.
  2. Activate PufferGo in the Plugins page.
  3. Go to the PufferGo settings page to connect your account and start building.
sections.faq:
Is PufferGo free to use?

Yes, we offer a free tier that’s enough to create a complete website. More advanced features are available with paid plans.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. We’ve eliminated all technical barriers, and top-tier AI models from both China and the US are here to assist you. If you run into any issues, feel free to contact us—we’re happy to help. Of course, if you do have technical skills, you’ll find it even smoother to use, but the difference isn’t huge.

How does it help with SEO?

We generate Tailwind HTML code that’s extremely clean and loads incredibly fast. Unlike traditional website builders (like Elementor), there’s no bloated, redundant code.

Where is the data stored?

Only your account-related data is stored on our cloud servers. All other data remains on your own server.
sections.changelog:
0.13.3

  • Color-Coded Page Structure Tree — The structure tree in the edit panel now highlights what matters: images, videos, links, and buttons stand out in bold indigo chips with type icons, headings show in green, editable text in blue, and layout containers fade into the background — so you can instantly spot the elements worth configuring.
  • Breadcrumb Navigation for Selected Elements — A new breadcrumb trail at the top of the tree shows exactly where the selected element sits in the page, and clicking any step jumps straight to that parent — no more hunting up through nested containers.
  • Always Know Where You Are — Selecting an element on the page now scrolls the tree so the selection sits centered in view with a brief highlight flash, its parents expand automatically, and the tree no longer scrolls sideways, so the selected row is always fully visible.
  • Smoother Tree Behavior — The first level is expanded by default, branches you collapse stay collapsed while you edit, and editing content no longer makes the tree jump away from where you scrolled.

0.13.3 (中文版)

  • 页面结构树分级配色 — 编辑面板的结构树现在按重要程度着色：图片、视频、链接、按钮用醒目的靛紫色块加类型图标，标题为绿色，可编辑文本为蓝色，布局容器则淡化为灰色——需要配置的元素一眼就能找到。
  • 选中元素的面包屑导航 — 结构树顶部新增面包屑路径，清楚展示当前选中元素在页面中的位置，点击任意一级即可直接跳到对应的父级容器，不用再一层层往上翻。
  • 选中位置一目了然 — 在页面上选中元素后，结构树会自动展开父级并将选中行滚动到视野正中，配合高亮闪烁提示；树不再左右滚动，选中行始终完整可见。
  • 结构树操作更顺手 — 默认展开第一层结构；你手动折叠的分支在编辑过程中会保持折叠；编辑内容时树也不会再自己跳走，停留在你正在查看的位置。

0.13.2

  • Automatic Alt Text for Gallery Images — Logos, testimonial photos, and other images in carousel/marquee-style blocks now carry their own ALT text field, so search engines and screen readers get meaningful descriptions instead of blank or generic text — better for SEO and accessibility.
  • Smarter Image Selection — When you pick an image from the media library for a block, its ALT text and title are now automatically filled in from the library (only if you haven’t already set your own), and you’ll get a heads-up if an image is still missing ALT text. Previously saved images also now show their real file name instead of a generated guess.

0.13.2 (中文版)

  • 图册类图片自动带上 ALT 文本 — 轮播、跑马灯等区块里的 Logo、客户头像等图片现在都自带独立的 ALT 文本字段，搜索引擎和屏幕阅读器能读到有意义的描述，而不是空白或笼统的文字，对 SEO 和无障碍访问更友好。
  • 更智能的选图体验 — 在区块中从媒体库选图时，会自动带入该图片在媒体库中的 ALT 文本和标题（仅在你还没手动填写时生效），如果图片仍缺少 ALT 文本还会提醒你补充；已保存到媒体库的图片现在会显示真实文件名，而不是系统猜测的名字。

0.13.1

  • Improved AI Usage Insights — AI generation requests across the site builder, editor, chat, and image tools now carry a scene tag behind the scenes, giving our team clearer visibility into how each AI feature is used so we can prioritize improvements and troubleshoot issues faster.

0.13.1 (中文版)

  • AI 使用场景标识优化 — 站点搭建、编辑器、聊天、图片工具等各类 AI 生成请求现在会在后台附带场景标识，帮助我们更清晰地了解各项 AI 功能的实际使用情况，从而更精准地优化产品和排查问题。

0.13.0

  • Bulk Product Import/Export via Excel — Add or update your entire catalog by uploading a spreadsheet, and export your current products to Excel for backup or offline editing — no more adding products one by one.
  • Redesigned Visual Editing Experience — The block editing panel has been reorganized for a smoother workflow: images, text, and video on configurable blocks are now edited directly through the config panel, the quick-style panel gained text color/size/alignment controls and a reworked spacing and device-preview toolbar, and shared content controls now surface more consistently across block types.
  • Rendering & Editor Reliability — Fixed several front-end display issues with configurable (Alpine-powered) blocks, including carousels whose autoplay toggle and interval settings weren’t actually taking effect, large containers being wrongly treated as icons in the editor, and site-wide generated components that could not be edited or rendered incorrectly.
  • New Section Templates — Added several new ready-to-use pattern components, including a product catalog with category carousel, to speed up page building.
  • Homepage Setup Reminder — If your WordPress Reading Settings aren’t pointing at the homepage PufferGo built for you, you’ll now see a dismissible notice with a one-click fix, so your site doesn’t end up showing a raw blog feed instead of a proper homepage.

0.13.0 (中文版)

  • Excel 批量导入导出产品 — 通过上传表格批量新增或更新整个产品目录，也可将现有产品导出为 Excel 备份或线下编辑，无需再逐个手动添加。
  • 可视化编辑体验重构 — 重新梳理了区块编辑面板的操作流程：配置型区块的图片、文字、视频改为统一通过配置面板编辑；快速样式面板新增文字颜色/字号/对齐控制，并重做了间距设置与设备预览工具条；公共内容编辑控件在各类区块中呈现更加一致。
  • 渲染与编辑器稳定性 — 修复了配置型（Alpine 驱动）区块的多处问题，包括轮播图的自动播放开关和间隔设置此前不生效的问题、编辑器中大容器被误判为图标的问题，以及整站生成的组件无法配置或渲染异常的情况。
  • 新增区块模板 — 新增多个可直接使用的预制区块组件，包括带分类轮播的产品目录区块，帮助你更快搭建页面。
  • 首页设置提醒 — 如果 WordPress 阅读设置未指向 PufferGo 为你搭建的首页，后台会出现可关闭的提醒，并提供一键修复，避免网站首页误显示为原始博客列表。

0.12.0

  • Three-Level Navigation Menus — Your header menus now support up to three levels, so large catalogs and solution ranges stay organized. The mega (“full-width”) header shows sub-categories as columns, standard headers use fly-out panels, and mobile turns deep menus into a tidy indented accordion. Menu items and product categories also gained a Description field, giving the mega layout richer, card-style entries.
  • Product Category Filtering — The product listing page now has a category tree sidebar for drill-down browsing instead of a flat pill bar. Each category shows a live product count (de-duplicated and rolled up from sub-categories, so a parent reflects everything beneath it), an arrow marks branches you can expand, and on mobile the filters tuck neatly into a slide-out drawer. All links are shareable, back-button friendly, and SEO-clean.
  • Easier Product Browsing — In the List view, the entire product card is now clickable — not just the image — so visitors reach product details with far less precision required.
  • Related Products on Detail Pages — Each product page now shows a “Related Products” row beneath the inquiry form, keeping visitors engaged with more of your range if they don’t inquire right away. Recommendations start with items in the same category, fall back to sibling categories, and are ranked by name similarity so same-series models surface first — all fully automatic, no setup.
  • Rendering Reliability — Fixed several front-end display issues with configurable (Alpine-powered) blocks, including cases where site-wide generated components could not be edited or rendered incorrectly.

0.12.0 (中文版)

  • 三级导航菜单 — 头部菜单现支持最多三级，产品线和解决方案多也能层次分明。全宽（巨幕）头部把子分类排成分栏，普通头部用侧滑面板，移动端则自动折叠成清爽的缩进手风琴。菜单项与产品分类还新增了「描述」字段，让巨幕布局呈现更丰富的卡片式条目。
  • 产品分类筛选 — 产品列表页由原来的一排扁平分类胶囊，升级为可逐级下钻的左侧分类树。每个分类带实时产品数量（跨子分类去重汇总，父级能真实反映其下全部产品），可展开的分支有箭头提示，移动端筛选收进侧边抽屉。所有链接可分享、可后退、对 SEO 友好。
  • 产品浏览更顺手 — 列表视图下，整张产品卡片任意位置都可点击进入详情，不再只有图片可点，访客不用精准点图也能轻松打开。
  • 详情页相关产品推荐 — 每个产品详情页在询盘表单下方新增「相关产品」一行：优先催促访客询盘，若暂不询盘，再用相关产品继续留住他。推荐先取同分类产品，不够则取兄弟分类，并按名称相似度排序，让同系列型号自动排在最前——全程自动，无需任何配置。
  • 渲染稳定性 — 修复了配置型（Alpine 驱动）区块的多处前端显示问题，包括整站生成的组件无法配置、以及个别渲染异常的情况。

0.11.3

  • AI HTML Import Fix — Resolved a styling issue when importing AI-generated HTML from third-party tools, ensuring imported pages display correctly on the front end.

0.11.3 (中文版)

  • AI HTML 导入修复 — 修复从第三方 AI 工具导入 HTML 时，部分区块样式丢失的问题，确保导入页面在前端完整还原。

0.11.2

  • Clickable Parent Menu Items — Top-level navigation items with a real URL are now directly clickable (e.g., Products links to the product archive). Items with # or empty URL retain the dropdown-only behavior. Smart URL-based detection with zero configuration.
  • AI Page Stability — Resolved PHP warnings in AI-generated pages related to block supports, improving rendering reliability.

0.11.2 (中文版)

  • Header 一级菜单可点击 — 带子菜单的导航项若设置了真实 URL，可直接点击跳转（如 Products → 产品归档页）；URL 为 # 或空时保持下拉展开行为。基于 URL 智能判定，零配置。
  • AI 页面稳定性修复 — 消除 AI 生成页面中区块支持的 PHP Warning，提升页面渲染稳定性。

0.11.1

  • Rebranded for Export Businesses — Updated plugin name, Dashboard heading, and descriptions to better reflect the focus on export businesses and B2B manufacturers. The new tagline “AI Website Builder for Export” makes it easier for foreign trade businesses to find and identify the plugin.

0.11.1 (中文版)

  • 品牌名称更新，突出外贸定位 — 更新插件名称、Dashboard 大标题及描述文案，突出「外贸独立站AI建站专家」定位，方便外贸用户搜索识别。

0.11.0

  • Faster, More Reliable Global Performance — Upgraded global content delivery to ensure your website loads quickly and reliably for customers worldwide, improving both user experience and search engine rankings.

0.11.0 (中文版)

  • 全球性能提速 — 升级全球内容分发基础设施，确保网站在全球范围内快速、稳定加载，提升访客体验与搜索引擎表现。

0.10.9

  • Patterns Now Included in Published Plugin — Component templates you created are now correctly included in the release package. Previously, they were accidentally left out, so customers installing the plugin wouldn’t see them.
  • Component Insertions Always Up to Date — When you insert a component into a page, it now always reflects your latest edits. No more seeing outdated versions after making changes.

0.10.9 (中文版)

  • 组件模板随插件正常发布 — 你做好的组件模板现在会随插件一起打包发布，之前因为打包疏漏，客户安装后看不到这些模板，本次已修复。
  • 插入组件始终是最新版本 — 修改组件后再插入页面，现在会直接拉取最新内容，不会再出现”改了却没生效”的情况。

0.10.8

  • Settings Cleanup — Removed the header/footer template selectors and content template configuration from the Settings page. These options are now managed automatically by the system, reducing clutter and simplifying your setup experience.

0.10.8 (中文版)

  • 设置页精简 — 移除了设置页面中的 Header/Footer 模板选择器和内容模板配置，这些选项现由系统自动管理，设置过程更简洁。

0.10.7

  • Showroom Navigation Fully Restored — The one-click Showroom import now correctly builds the complete B2B header menu, including Products, Solutions, Case Studies, Blog, and About Us with its sub-pages. A previous fix had accidentally removed these items; they are fully restored.

0.10.7 (中文版)

  • 样板间导航菜单完整恢复 — 一键导入样板间后，顶部导航栏现在会正确生成完整的 B2B 菜单结构，包括产品、解决方案、案例研究、博客及关于我们（含子页面）。此前一次修复误删了这些菜单项，本次已完整还原。

0.10.6

  • Conversational Site Profile Copilot — The site information setup has been redesigned from a one-shot form into a step-by-step conversational Copilot experience. AI now guides you through each question one at a time, making it easier and more intuitive to provide the details needed to build your site. A one-shot extraction mode is also available for those who prefer to paste everything at once.
  • AI Analysis Preserves Your Existing Input — When AI re-analyses your site profile, it now only fills in empty fields instead of overwriting information you have already provided. Your manual edits are always respected.
  • Language Defaults Follow WordPress Settings — The default language selection now automatically inherits your WordPress site language, so you don’t need to set it again during PufferGo setup.

0.10.6 (中文版)

  • 对话式站点信息 Copilot — 站点信息收集从一次性表单升级为分步对话式体验，AI 逐步引导你回答每个问题，填写过程更轻松直观。同时也保留了一次性信息提取模式，方便希望快速填入全部内容的用户。
  • AI 分析不再覆盖已填内容 — AI 重新分析站点信息时，现在只会自动填充空白字段，不会覆盖你已经手动填写的内容，确保你的编辑始终被保留。
  • 语言默认值跟随 WordPress 设置 — 默认语言自动继承 WordPress 站点语言设置，无需在 PufferGo 配置中重复选择。

0.10.5

  • Reach Customers in Their Own Language — PufferGo now offers built-in multilingual support through Polylang integration, enabling your site to serve audiences in English, German, Spanish, Arabic, Japanese, and dozens of other languages. Each visitor is greeted by a page tailored to their market — a buyer in Frankfurt and a buyer in Dubai each see content that speaks directly to them, helping you build trust and improve conversions across borders. Setup is fully guided: PufferGo installs and configures everything in a single step, with no manual plugin management required.
  • Confident, Protected Primary Language Setup — A redesigned setup flow guides you through selecting your site’s primary language and then locks the choice in place, safeguarding your content structure against accidental changes. You make the decision once, clearly, and PufferGo preserves it from that point on.
  • Efficient Interface Translation — The new translation workspace provides a dedicated progress indicator for each language, giving you full visibility into what has been completed and what remains. A built-in AI Translate option generates professional translations on demand, reducing what was once hours of manual work to a brief review.
  • Improved Stability and Reliability — We have strengthened the publishing engine with stricter validation and a graceful fallback for servers missing certain components, resolving the rare blank-screen issue and helping ensure your site stays consistently available.

0.10.5 (中文版)

  • 用客户的母语触达每一位买家 — PufferGo 正式接入 Polylang，提供内置的多语言支持，让你的独立站可面向英语、德语、西班牙语、阿拉伯语、日语等数十种语言的受众。每位访客都会看到贴合其所在市场的页面——法兰克福的采购商与迪拜的买家，各自看到的都是直达需求的内容，帮助你在跨境贸易中建立信任、提升转化。整个过程全程引导，PufferGo 一步即可完成安装与配置，无需手动管理插件。
  • 主语言设置，一次选定且受保护 — 全新的配置流程将引导你选定网站主语言，并在确认后自动锁定，避免误操作影响内容结构。你只需清晰地决定一次，PufferGo 便会持续为你守护这一设置。
  • 高效的界面翻译体验 — 全新的翻译工作台为每种语言提供独立的进度指示，让已完成与待处理的内容一目了然。内置的 AI 翻译功能可按需生成专业译文，将以往耗时数小时的人工翻译，简化为一次快速审校。
  • 更稳定、更可靠 — 我们强化了发布引擎，引入更严格的校验机制，并在服务器缺少特定组件时优雅降级，修复了极少数情况下的白屏问题，帮助确保你的网站持续稳定在线。

0.9.95

  • Cleaner Template Import — Fixed an issue where importing a starter template would automatically create unnecessary CPT archive and blog placeholder pages. Imports now only create what’s actually needed.
  • Smarter Plugin Activation — PufferGo no longer imports starter template data on plugin activation. Templates are now only imported when you explicitly choose to, giving you a cleaner starting point.

0.9.95 (中文版)

  • 样板间导入更干净 — 修复了导入样板间时会自动生成多余的 CPT 归档页和博客占位页的问题，现在只会创建真正需要的内容。
  • 插件激活更简洁 — 插件激活时不再自动导入样板间数据，样板间内容仅在你主动选择时才会导入，给你一个更干净的起点。

0.9.94

  • More Reliable Site Setup — Fixed an issue where the sample content, homepage, and navigation menus could be missing after the initial setup. Setup steps are now retried automatically if anything was incomplete, so you always get a fully configured site.

0.9.94 (中文版)

  • 建站初始化更稳定 — 修复了初始化完成后，样板间首页或导航菜单有时未能正常生成的问题。现在每个步骤会自动检测并补全，确保建站后网站结构完整就绪。

0.9.93

  • Instant Style Setup on Activation — PufferGo now automatically sets up your design system the moment the plugin is activated, so your site’s colors, fonts, and style settings are ready to use right away — no extra steps needed.
  • Compatibility Fix for Popular Themes — Fixed an issue where themes like Kadence would incorrectly show a block theme compatibility warning. The prompt now only appears when it’s actually relevant to your setup.

0.9.93 (中文版)

  • 激活即完成风格初始化 — 插件激活后自动完成设计系统配置，网站的配色、字体等样式设定立即就绪，无需额外手动操作。
  • 修复主题兼容性误提示 — 修复了 Kadence 等主题在非区块模式下错误弹出兼容性提示的问题，现在该提示只会在真正需要时才出现。

0.9.92

  • Auto-Install GeneratePress on Activation — PufferGo now automatically installs the GeneratePress theme in the background when the plugin is first activated, so your header/footer system works right away without any manual setup.
  • New Setup API for One-Click Site Configuration — Added a setup endpoint that the PufferGo extension can call to install the theme, activate it, and update your site URL in one step — making the initial onboarding seamless.

  • 重构：CSS 架构 — 6 个 CSS 文件合并为 4 个，职责单一：puffergo.css（主题防御与布局）、token-bridge.css（设计令牌映射）、tailwind.css（编译产物）、src/tailwind.css（构建源码，不打包进生产）。4 份重复防御代码合并为 1 个统一作用域，编译产物减少约 33%。
  • 修复：跨主题兼容性 — button、input、textarea、select 元素重置范围从仅 header 扩展到所有 PufferGo 区域（产品列表、产品详情、全页模板）。防御 Kadence、GeneratePress、Astra 等主流主题的样式污染。作用域重置不使用 !important，Tailwind utility 类正常生效。
  • 修复：CSS 加载顺序 — 区块级 Tailwind CSS 正确声明依赖模板 Tailwind CSS，避免 mobile-first 基础 utility 覆盖响应式断点 utility。
  • 修复：产品规格手风琴 — 恢复产品详情页规格参数的折叠/展开功能。补上缺失的 data-toggle 属性和图标切换 CSS。
  • 修复：联系表单国际化 — 联系表单区块的默认字段标签现已正确包裹翻译函数。

0.9.51

  • New: Product Video Gallery — Product listing and detail pages now support video in the gallery. Add product videos alongside images to showcase features more effectively — rich media content improves user engagement and dwell time, both positive signals for Google SEO ranking.
  • Improved: i18n Architecture — All translation keys migrated to English. Ready for WPML, Polylang, and other multilingual plugins. Contact form, design system, visual editor, and AI page builder are now fully translatable.
  • Fixed: Translation Scanner — Dynamic strings now use sprintf() instead of template literals, fixing incomplete translation extraction.
  • Fixed: Missing Text Domain — Added missing puffergo text domain in AI Page Builder.

  • Improved: Translation Files — Regenerated .po, .mo, .json with complete Chinese translations.

  • 新功能：产品视频画廊 — 产品列表页和详情页的 Gallery 现已支持视频。在产品图片中加入视频展示，更直观地呈现产品特性——丰富的多媒体内容提升用户参与度与页面停留时长，助力 Google SEO 排名。

  • 改进：国际化架构 — 所有翻译键统一为英文，兼容 WPML、Polylang 等多语言插件。联系表单、设计系统、可视化编辑器、AI 建站全部支持翻译。
  • 修复：翻译扫描 — 动态文案改用 sprintf()，修复翻译提取不全的问题。
  • 修复：缺失 Text Domain — 补充 AI Page Builder 中缺失的 text domain。
  • 改进：翻译文件 — 重新生成翻译文件，中文翻译补全。

0.9.50

  • Fixed: Site Profile Logo Upload — Resolved an issue where the site profile page could not upload or change the brand LOGO. The WordPress media library now loads correctly, ensuring smooth brand identity management across your entire site.
  • Fixed: Visual Editor Button Interaction — Fixed a bug in the SectionTree visual editor where clicking on action buttons had no response when a non-first element was selected. All editing controls now work reliably regardless of which section is active.
  • Fixed: Video Media Selection — The media picker in both the AI Edit Modal and PufferGo Tool now correctly supports video file selection, enabling richer multimedia content that improves user engagement and dwell time — both positive signals for search engine ranking.
  • Improved: AI Edit Image Reference — Optimized the image reference attachment flow for AI-assisted editing: limited to one reference image per request for more focused results, with clearer user feedback when the limit is reached.
  • Improved: Element ID Tracking — Enhanced the HTML preprocessing engine to correctly preserve and prefix element IDs when combining multiple blocks, preventing duplicate IDs and improving DOM structure quality for better SEO compliance.

  • Improved: Internationalization — Updated English and Chinese translation files with new media picker strings for video selection support.

  • 修复：站点画像 LOGO 上传 — 解决了站点信息页面无法上传或更换品牌 LOGO 的问题。WordPress 媒体库现在能正确加载，确保全站品牌标识管理顺畅无阻。

  • 修复：可视化编辑器按钮交互 — 修复了 SectionTree 可视化编辑器中，选中非首个元素时操作按钮无响应的问题。无论选中哪个区块，所有编辑控件现在都能正常工作。
  • 修复：视频媒体选择 — AI 编辑弹窗和 PufferGo 工具中的媒体选择器现已正确支持视频文件选择，方便添加更丰富的多媒体内容，提升用户参与度与页面停留时长——搜索引擎排名的正向信号。
  • 改进：AI 编辑图片参考 — 优化 AI 辅助编辑的图片参考附件流程：每次请求限制为一张参考图，聚焦生成更精准的结果，超出限制时提供明确提示。
  • 改进：元素 ID 追踪 — 增强 HTML 预处理引擎，在合并多个区块时正确保留并添加前缀元素 ID，避免重复 ID，提升 DOM 结构质量，更利于搜索引擎抓取与 SEO 合规。
  • 改进：国际化 — 更新英文和中文翻译文件，覆盖新增的视频选择相关文案。

0.9.45

  • New: Customer Inquiry Management System — Built-in WordPress contact form management module. Collect, view, and manage all customer inquiries from a dedicated admin panel with native Gutenberg block support — no third-party form plugin needed. …

short_description: AI website builder built for export. Quickly create high-converting B2B brand sites optimized for Google SEO.
description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
